grammar_target: too…to / enough to / in order to（不定詞の発展構文）

captions.en: My sister has been training for the marathon every day.
In two more weeks she will run the race.
At first, she was too exhausted to run ten kilometers and would end up walking halfway.
Her body could not yet keep up with her goal.
But she kept making a steady effort and gradually learned how to control her breathing.
Lately she has enough strength to finish the full ten kilometers.
I go out to the riverbank to watch her.
In order to reach her goal, she runs every day.
To have such a clear purpose is something bright and admirable.
I am sure that on the race day, she will cross the finish line with a smile.
On that day she will be not only a runner but also someone who has turned steady effort into real confidence.
